summary.headline: Aurobindo Q4 FY26 revenue ₹8,853 crore (flat-to-up YoY, Revlimid-hit base), EBITDA ₹1,801 crore at 20.3%; FY27 EBITDA margin guided north of 21%.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 and FY26 both set record revenue and EBITDA, with FY26 revenue at ₹33,653 crore (+6% YoY, +9.5% ex-gRevlimid) and EBITDA at ₹6,856 crore (20.4% margin). Q4 ex-gRevlimid revenue grew 15.3% YoY (7% in USD), while US formulations fell 18% YoY in constant currency on the high Q4 FY25 gRevlimid base. Europe was the standout, up 30% YoY to ₹2,795 crore, and the company crossed €1 billion of annual European revenue. Management guided FY27 EBITDA margin to sustain and progressively improve to north of 21%, and called out biosimilars, the TheraNym CMO and Pen-G backward integration as medium-term drivers.

guidance_outlook: FY27 EBITDA margin expected to sustain and progressively improve to north of 21%; management declined to say whether this includes the forex tailwind.
US business aiming for $2 billion revenue over the near term; Eugia/Lannett timing: Lannett (~$300 million annual) expected to close early Q2 FY27, contributing about half-year in FY27.
Europe: management targets minimum double-digit growth in constant currency for the coming year.
Pen-G annualised output expected above 10,000 t at over 80% utilisation with consistent yields.
China OSD targeted to deliver profitable EBITDA contribution in FY27.
Biosimilars: about 3 US filings in 2026 (Omalizumab, Denosumab, Bevacizumab); 7-8 products in Europe and growth markets by 2030 plus 2-3 in the US.
capex_capacity: CMO Unit-1 (biologics, TheraNym/MSD) commissioning by end of 2026; first 60 KL capacity; PPQ batches in 2027; steady revenue from 2028.
CMO Unit-2 greenfield drug substance facility: commissioning expected 2029, revenue from 2031. Total planned mammalian cell culture capacity about 120,000 litres across three product schedules.
Biosimilars total investment to date about $450 million (CapEx and OpEx since July 2018); greenfield CMO facility about $175 million.
Pen-G: 17 fermenters; capacity can be flexed by running more fermenters, with focus on yields and avoiding inventory build.
Lannett acquisition pending FTC approval; topical ointment launch, plus oral, transdermal and respiratory pipeline from Dayton and Raleigh facilities.
Khandelwal Laboratories non-oncology acquisition: about $32 million consideration paid in Q4.
demand_pricing: Q4 operating cost excluding R&D up 11% QoQ and 17% YoY, mainly power and fuel for the Pen-G plant as it ramped; captive 6-APA use cut raw material cost.
Solvent prices up about 2.5x-2.7x and freight costs rose sharply in March-May 2026, offsetting some rupee benefit.
Forex sensitivity: 1% INR depreciation vs USD adds about ₹100 crore to EBITDA; euro impact seen as small with EUR/USD at 1.16-1.17.
Biosimilars pricing: US price erosion built in at up to ~60%; Europe 75-85%; targeted gross margin 65-75% for biosimilars.
Omalizumab expected at $2-2.2 billion market post-competition; pegfilgrastim $3.5-4 billion global market (per management).

qa_highlights.question: Why did operating costs ex-R&D rise 11% QoQ and 17% YoY, and will this continue?
qa_highlights.answer: Mainly power and fuel for the Pen-G plant, which ramped in Q4. Costs will stay at this level, but captive 6-APA lowers raw material cost and lifts gross margin.

qa_highlights.question: What EBITDA loss came from new projects in FY26, and will they break even in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Pen-G and 6-APA lost about ₹200 crore+ in FY26 but turned EBITDA-positive in Q4 on operating leverage and better yields. China plant incurred a loss and is expected to be profitable in FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Timeline to the $2 billion US revenue mark, and Lannett closing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management would not commit to a date, saying it could take 1-2 years, faster if acquisitions materialise. Lannett expected to close early Q2 FY27 after FTC delays from a 76-day government shutdown.

qa_highlights.question: Europe growth outlook after crossing €1 billion?
qa_highlights.answer: Management targets at least double-digit growth in constant currency, supported by more than 10 China-sourced products already launched and tech-transfer products.

qa_highlights.question: Biologics CMO revenue timing and TheraNym strategy?
qa_highlights.answer: Unit-1 commissioning by end-2026 with steady revenue from 2028; Unit-2 revenue from 2031. Long-term goal is a multi-customer CDMO by 2032, with MSD as anchor for about 10 years.

qa_highlights.question: Biosimilar margins and price erosion assumptions?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross margin of 65-75% at portfolio level; US erosion capped at about 60%, Europe 75-85%. Yields of 4-6 g/L and 2,500-5,000 L bioreactors seen as the cost-competitiveness basis.

qa_highlights.question: Does the 21% FY27 EBITDA margin guidance include the rupee tailwind?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO said it nets out cost pressures (solvents, freight, raw materials) and said the outcome is a combined effect, without confirming the exact split.

qa_highlights.question: Pen-G capacity and yields?
qa_highlights.answer: March output ~11,300 t and April ~10,800 t, with the company running 17 fermenters and balancing yield and inventory build.

risks_watch: Lannett FTC approval timing; management says the US $2 billion target depends on it and on in-licensing or ANDA deals.
Input cost inflation: solvents up 2.5-2.7x, freight rising, and Pen-G power and fuel costs; EBITDA margin depends on pass-through and yields.
US base business: constant-currency revenue fell 18% YoY in Q4; management said ~$400 million is a reasonable base, and seasonality is notable.
Eugia Unit III and Unit I are still awaiting US FDA EIR; launch pipeline visibility depends on those approvals.
Biosimilar competition (about 10-11 players per product); Ryzneuta launch delayed and still building brand story; Ashish Anvekar guided ADQUEY (eczema NCE) launch around Q2 FY27.
summary.management_tone: Confident on Europe, Pen-G, and FY27 margin direction, but cautious and hedged on US timelines ($2 billion goal, Lannett close) and deliberately non-committal on biosimilar market share and some pipeline items.
key_quotes: We expect EBITDA margins to sustain and progressively improve to north of 21%, reflecting the scale of our operations, execution capabilities and leveraging the new business lever.
Despite insignificant Revlimid product sales compared to Q4 FY25, EBITDA before Forex remained flat year-on-year growth and grew by 2% on quarter to ₹1,801 crores.
So, we are not looking at a 15%-20% market share in those territories. With the right cost of goods, we still believe there is enough opportunity for everyone.
Right now, we are a CMO, make no mistake about it. We are not a CDMO right now.
